decision_register.statement: The product is an installed desktop application for macOS and Windows.
decision_register.source: Explicit user confirmation in the project conversation.
decision_register.impact: Architecture, packaging, security, and runtime verification must cover both operating systems independently.
decision_register.resolution: Treat macOS and Windows as required targets; Windows behavior must be observed on Windows.

decision_register.statement: The desktop app owns and supervises an OpenCode v2 `serve` sidecar.
decision_register.source: Explicit user direction in the project conversation, including the correction that the server runs as a sidecar.
decision_register.impact: Do not use browser loopback evidence as desktop lifecycle/security evidence or silently adopt a shared ambient service.
decision_register.resolution: Package or provision the pinned server per platform; the selected app host must own startup, readiness, shutdown, and reaping.

decision_register.statement: Use Electron as the desktop host for the macOS and Windows app.
decision_register.source: Explicit user selection in the project conversation on 2026-09-28: 'electron으로 진행'.
decision_register.impact: Electron-specific host, renderer isolation, sidecar lifecycle, packaging and per-OS verification contracts govern the approved implementation increment.
decision_register.resolution: Electron is selected. Exact document-set packet r1 and its receipt are recorded; bounded synthetic-data Electron/OpenCode compatibility probes and bootstrap are authorized after current plan, product, design-spec and matching handoff gates are registered. Storage/retention, user/global config and credentials, ambient services, signing/public release/auto-update and external telemetry remain excluded or separately held.

decision_register.statement: The current bootstrap exposes no preview surface; preview isolation is verified separately before preview implementation.
decision_register.source: Revision 21 coordinator reconciliation of independent review finding CR3-4 against the current bootstrap renderer and approved product/design specs.
decision_register.impact: Prevents claiming preview isolation without a preview surface while preserving the later approved product capability.
decision_register.resolution: Require no iframe, webview, or preview surface and no subframe preload bridge in this bootstrap; add a separate reviewed preview-isolation gate before implementing preview.

acceptance.description: Electron, Tauri 2, and Neutralinojs are compared against the same macOS/Windows and app-owned OpenCode serve-sidecar requirements; Electron is explicitly selected by the user and recorded in a reviewed ADR before implementation.

The selected desktop shell runs a macOS and Windows development build with the exact app-owned OpenCode v2 serve sidecar, typed least-authority renderer API, the absence of a preview-capable surface in this bootstrap, and verified startup/readiness/shutdown/reaping.

Reproducible personal-use packages for macOS and Windows launch the OpenCode-backed workbench; exact app/sidecar hashes and platform-specific lifecycle evidence are recorded. This is a runtime milestone, not full PRD acceptance.

integrity.scope: Validate current design token and component sources

install.scope: Frozen install; may change local dependency store and contact configured registry if cache is insufficient

lint.scope: Uncached lint for all workspace projects including desktop shell

format.scope: Uncached format check for source projects

typecheck.scope: Uncached typecheck for all workspace projects

tests.scope: Uncached unit/integration tests with a pinned app-owned OpenCode v2 sidecar and synthetic workspace/config only; no user configuration or data

desktop-app-test.scope: Selected host/client admission and lifecycle tests using an owned disposable OpenCode sidecar; include exact server identity, readiness/authentication, event-gap handling, and process cleanup without user configuration

desktop-e2e-macos.scope: Development app E2E on macOS plus sender/frame/payload admission, navigation denial, privilege absence, absence of a preview surface and subframe preload in this bootstrap; actual preview isolation is a separate gate before preview implementation, sidecar readiness, visible disconnect followed by clean app-restart recovery, and owned-process lifecycle assertions.

desktop-e2e-windows.scope: Equivalent development app E2E on Windows with sender/frame/payload admission, navigation denial, privilege absence, absence of a preview surface and subframe preload in this bootstrap; actual preview isolation is a separate gate before preview implementation, sidecar readiness, visible disconnect followed by clean app-restart recovery, and owned-process lifecycle assertions.

desktop-build.scope: Build and hash the local macOS personal-use desktop artifact; no publication or signing. Cross-build output is not Windows runtime evidence.

desktop-build-windows.scope: Build and hash the local Windows personal-use desktop artifact on Windows; no publication or signing. Record the actual runner OS.

desktop-packaged-e2e.scope: On the exact packaged macOS app and OpenCode sidecar, assert sidecar identity/readiness and the minimal client flow; reject malformed renderer messages/navigation/popups; inspect privilege absence and absence of a preview surface and subframe preload in this bootstrap; actual preview isolation is a separate gate before preview implementation; inject startup failure, crash, timeout, service collision, disconnect; verify clean app-restart recovery, close/quit, and exact child reaping; bind app and sidecar hashes to evidence.

desktop-packaged-e2e-windows.scope: On Windows, run the exact packaged app and OpenCode sidecar; verify identity/readiness and the minimal client flow; reject malformed renderer messages/navigation/popups; inspect privilege absence and absence of a preview surface and subframe preload in this bootstrap; actual preview isolation is a separate gate before preview implementation; inject startup failure, crash, timeout, service collision, disconnect; verify clean app-restart recovery, close/quit, and exact child reaping; bind app and sidecar hashes. Match the macOS assertions or document an independently reviewed platform-specific equivalent.

desktop-bundle-inspection-macos.scope: Inspect the packaged macOS renderer for Node built-ins, secrets, bridge-only code, OpenCode server code/credentials and unsafe APIs; bind report to exact app and sidecar hashes and build evidence.

desktop-bundle-inspection-windows.scope: Inspect the packaged Windows renderer for Node built-ins, secrets, bridge-only code, OpenCode server code/credentials and unsafe APIs; bind report to exact app and sidecar hashes and build evidence.
